sentences.en: Lenses with two distinct optical powers are also called "bifocals".
sentences.zh: 具有两种不同视力效果的镜片也被称为‘双焦点镜’。

sentences.en: This looks longer than that, but it is an optical illusion.
sentences.zh: 这看起来比那长，但实际上这是一种视觉错觉。

sentences.en: Optical radar uses light, unlike normal radar, which uses radio waves.
sentences.zh: 光学雷达使用光，不同于通常使用的无线电波雷达。

senses.zh: 视力的，视觉的；有助于视力的，光学的；光读取的，光存贮的；（装置）光电的
